scripts.stop: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const port = process.env.PORT || 3000; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms)); const check = () => { try { return execSync('lsof -nP -iTCP:' + port + ' -sTCP:LISTEN -t 2>/dev/null || true', { stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }).toString().trim(); } catch { return ''; } }; (async () => { const initial = check(); if (!initial) { console.log('No process is listening on port ' + port + '.'); return; } const pids = [...new Set(initial.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean))]; console.log('Stopping process(es) on port ' + port + ': ' + pids.join(', ')); for (const pid of pids) { try { execSync('kill -TERM ' + pid + ' 2>/dev/null || true'); } catch {} } for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) { const remaining = check(); if (!remaining) { console.log('Port ' + port + ' is free.'); return; } await sleep(250); } console.log('Graceful shutdown timed out. Forcing kill on port ' + port + '...'); for (const pid of [...new Set(check().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean))]) { try { execSync('kill -KILL ' + pid + ' 2>/dev/null || true'); } catch {} } for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) { if (!check()) { console.log('Port ' + port + ' is free after forced shutdown.'); return; } await sleep(250); } console.error('Port ' + port + ' is still in use after forced shutdown.'); process.exit(1); })().catch((error) => { console.error('Could not stop port ' + port + ':', error.message); process.exit(1); });"
